scope: Design declarations and isolated fixtures, not application implementation

checks.name: Header length counts UTF-8 bytes and excludes the header
Every single split position reconstructs the same message
Zero and excessive lengths are rejected from the header alone
Invalid UTF-8, JSON and non-object bodies are rejected
EOF with an incomplete header or body is not a complete message
The exact maximum body succeeds and one extra byte is rejected

drizzle.fixture: Drizzle RC compatibility, not application acceptance

checks.name: Forward migration preserves stored choices and adds the declared default
Reopen does not reapply completed migrations
Strict codec rejects malformed writes without modifying data
Lenient reads handle malformed JSON in both direct and relational projections
Null and numeric zero retain distinct storage values
Empty relation presence and absence match actual facts
ORM empty IN semantics are explicit; public queries must reject empty operands
Unique identities, foreign keys, CHECK and short transactions enforce constraints
A failing pending migration rolls back schema, rows and applied history
Reopen after failed migration preserves the last committed database
